shortDescription: Multi-tenant remote monitoring and management for MSPs, with cross-platform agents and durable endpoint operations.
longDescription: Strata RMM is an open-source, SaaS-ready remote monitoring and management platform for MSPs. It provides tenant-isolated client and site management, cross-platform agents, monitoring, durable endpoint operations, approvals, automation, patching, remote access, audit evidence, reporting, and branded deployment portals.
